tools.hmmsearch: # hmmsearch :: search profile(s) against a sequence database
tools.iqtree2: IQ-TREE version 3.1.3 for Linux x86 64-bit built Jul 26 2026
tools.famsa: FAMSA (Fast and Accurate Multiple Sequence Alignment)

step4_qc.description: QC, topology & domain architecture for all candidates

domain_signal.method: hmmsearch vs PF01036 (Type-I core) and PF18761 (heliorhodopsin), permissive E=10

membrane_topology.method: Kyte-Doolittle sliding window (w=19); DESCRIPTIVE hydrophobicity features only
membrane_topology.rationale: rhodopsin TM helices are polar (retinal pocket, proton wire); raw KD under-counts 7-TM, so authoritative 7-TM signal is taken from PF01036 domain completeness, not KD. DeepTMHMM not used: biolib local execution deprecated -> remote-only, non-reproducible for thousands of sequences.

retinal_lysine.method: hmmalign to model-appropriate Pfam (PF01036 for Type-I-primary, PF18761 for HeR-primary); read the invariant retinal-K match-state column
retinal_lysine.validation: seeds map retinal-K to a single 100%-conserved match column (BR P02945 precursor K229 = mature K216); all 15 seeds recovered as K
retinal_lysine.note: ~30% of PF01036-domain proteins lack the canonical Schiff-base lysine (divergent homologs, fragments, and misannotations e.g. yeast HSP30 family P25619/P38079/Q12117); these are flagged for routing to rhodopsin_like/partial, never force-classified.

architecture.method: envelope-relative N/C truncation, extra-Pfam fusion detection, length-band flag

step5_membership.description: Evidence-vector membership model (transparent rules) + benchmark calibration
step5_membership.design: Interpretable evidence vector -> continuous score -> transparent tier rules. NOT a trained ML model, but the full ML-ready schema (per-axis evidence, continuous score, gate booleans) is persisted so a classifier can be dropped in later.

evidence_axes.e_retinal: retinal-binding Schiff-base lysine present (0/1) - DEFINING feature
evidence_axes.e_margin: sigmoid(score_PF01036 - score_PF18761; x0=0, k=40) - separates HeR companion
evidence_axes.e_homology: best seed identity x coverage (DIAMOND blastp vs 15 seeds)
evidence_axes.e_topology: sigmoid(KD kd_max; x0=1.6, k=0.4) - supporting, down-weighted

step5_membership.strategy_comparison_note: full_evidence dominates all baselines. pfam_only (naive Pfam membership) precision=0.329, specificity=0.563 -> accepts heliorhodopsins, fragments and HSP30-clan proteins; this quantifies why Pfam membership alone is insufficient.

curation.reason_hsp30: fungal/yeast HSP30 family: share PF01036 clan fold but are NOT retinal-binding rhodopsins (no Schiff-base lysine, no seed homology).
curation.reason_partial: genuine Type-I (old H. halobium BR/HR strain records) but C-terminal retinal-K region absent as sequenced -> kept positive, tagged partial.

at_best_F1_thr_0.87.FP_detail: P96787_frag = synthetic fragment of a real archaerhodopsin, retains retinal-K -> defensibly rhodopsin-like, not a true error at tier level.
at_best_F1_thr_0.87.FN_detail: exactly the 4 partial positives (score ~0.68) lacking retinal-K -> correctly DEMOTED to rhodopsin_like, not force-classified.

step5_membership.threshold_rationale: HeR band max on benchmark = 0.834; complete Type-I positive p05 ~ 0.90. high cut 0.86 sits ABOVE the HeR band so heliorhodopsins never enter the Type-I core. Retinal-lysine AND positive Type-I margin AND complete core are HARD gates for the top tiers.
step5_membership.categorisation_rules: no domain -> rejected; HeR-primary -> rejected (companion module, never Type-I); score>=high AND retinal-K AND +margin AND complete -> high_confidence_type_I; score>=putative + domain -> putative_type_I (if retinal-K) else rhodopsin_like; score>=rhodopsin_like -> rhodopsin_like (no retinal-K) else ambiguous; else rejected. high_confidence + PDB xref -> promoted to confirmed_type_I.

consistency_checks.seeds: 8 confirmed + 4 high_confidence + 3 rejected (the 3 rejected are the HeR seeds -> belong to HeR companion module, correct)

step6_redundancy.description: Tiered redundancy reduction (nested identity clusterings) with multi-factor representative selection.

scope.type_I_note: all membership categories EXCEPT rejected (rejected = 377 HeR-primary + 98 sub-threshold PF01036 hits). rhodopsin_like + ambiguous are retained in the module and clustered, but tagged so downstream steps can restrict to the high-confidence backbone.
scope.her_note: clustered SEPARATELY as a distinct module, never merged with Type-I.

step6_redundancy.tool: MMseqs2 18.8cc5c easy-cluster, greedy set-cover (--cluster-mode 0), bidirectional coverage (--cov-mode 0) except exact-NR (cov-mode 1, full-length).
step6_redundancy.nested_partition: each tier is a FULL partition of its module (every sequence assigned a cluster at every tier); no sequence discarded -> any cluster expandable to its complete member list.

representative_selection.method: MULTI-FACTOR composite (NOT longest-wins); overrides MMseqs2 arbitrary centroid.
representative_selection.annotation_richness: reviewed(+0.5) + PDB xref(+0.3) + specific protein name(+0.2)
representative_selection.tie_break: deterministic by (composite desc, length desc, acc asc); exactly one rep/cluster.

step7_phylogeny.scope: Type-I backbone reference phylogeny + EPA-ng placement of larger tiers

reference_set.source: backbone tier (40% identity MMseqs2 clusters) representatives

core_alignment.method: hmmalign to PF01036, MATCH-STATE columns only (not full-length)
core_alignment.rationale: backbone spans extreme length heterogeneity (55-2650 aa incl. 104 fusions/extended, e.g. enzyme-rhodopsin guanylyl-cyclase PF00211); full-length MSA not homology-valid

trimming.note: overrides config gappyout for this profile-HMM core; gappyout over-aggressive (224->122) because match-state extraction already yields homology-clean columns; -gt 0.2 removes only 5 near-empty columns while retaining conserved core

tree_inference.model_selection: ModelFinder Plus (MFP), tested up to 616 protein models
tree_inference.note: -safe dropped in final run (numerically stable, no underflow); ModelFinder fixed to best model on final run after a crash to skip 17-min re-selection
caveats: saturated pairwise distances warning (expected for divergent superfamily)
deep backbone nodes poorly resolved (only ~30% branches well-supported) - inherent to 40% identity superfamily-wide sampling; shallow clades better resolved
tree_inference.rooting: PRESENTED UNROOTED (no biological outgroup imposed; HeR NOT used as outgroup per design)
tree_inference.eukaryotic_composition_note: 236/278 reference tips are Eukaryota - expected skew of the 40% backbone of the whole PF01036 pool, not a sampling artifact of this build step

placement.model_substitution_rationale: EPA-ng/libpll does not support IQ-TREE Q.PFAM matrix nor +R free-rate; LG+G is standard general protein model, gamma alpha ML-optimized on fixed reference; placement is on fixed reference topology so robust to modest model approximation
placement.query_alignment: query core aligned to PF01036, masked to the same 219 reference columns

step8_subfamily.scope: Subfamily assignment for Type-I rhodopsins: phylogeny-first, transparent rules; reference tips labeled then propagated to placed queries.

inputs.seed_curation: seeds/seed_metadata.tsv (12 Type-I seeds; 8 present as reference tips, 4 collapsed into 40% clusters represented by B0R2U4/B0R633/N0DKS8)
inputs.diamond_homology: DIAMOND best-hit vs seed-labeled sequences (subfamily transfer)

method.principle: Phylogeny-first, transparent RULES over curated seeds + DIAMOND best-hit + tree topology. NOT trained ML. Sequences are never force-classified.
reference_tip_rules_in_priority_order: seed_curated: a reference tip that IS a curated seed inherits its curated subfamily
diamond_besthit: else, label = subfamily of best DIAMOND hit among seed-labeled sequences
tree_neighbor: tips with no DIAMOND signal inherit nearest labeled tip by patristic distance IF that distance <= rescue_cut
unclassified_typeI: no DIAMOND signal AND nearest labeled tip beyond rescue_cut
method.rescue_cut_basis: 75th percentile of nearest-labeled-neighbor patristic distances among DIAMOND-labeled reference tips (data-driven, not arbitrary)
method.placed_query_propagation: EPA-ng edge-consensus: each confident placement (best LWR >= 0.50) inherits the consensus subfamily of reference tips adjacent to its best placement edge. jplace edge tokens {n} rewritten to [&edge=n] and read via dendropy node annotations.
method.discordance_flag: a labeled reference tip is flagged tree_discordant when its 3 nearest labeled neighbors ALL carry a different subfamily (honest low-confidence signal, not auto-corrected)

validation.seed_recovery: all 9 seed-representatives recovered their exact curated subfamily; W8VZW3 (chloride_pump_NTQ), collapsed at 40% with the Na+ pump seed, was correctly resolved via its EPA-ng placement (placement resolves beyond the 40% cluster merge)
validation.channelrhodopsin_probe: the 2 channelrhodopsin seeds (H2EZZ6, Q8RUT8) are sister tips (patristic 0.101; MRCA subtends exactly 2 tips)
validation.cohesion: all DIAMOND-labeled subfamilies show within-subfamily patristic cohesion ratio >1 vs the global mean (4.646); tightest sodium_pump 2.79, loosest enzyme_rhodopsin 1.21
validation.discordance_interpretation: 37 discordant reference tips: 33 have DIAMOND identity <0.35 (expected deep-divergence noise); only B0R633 (SR-I, id 1.0) is a local tree-density artifact

caveats: The backbone tree is near-saturated at the superfamily scale (Step 7); deep internal support is limited, so labels for the most divergent tips are lower confidence and transparently flagged (tree_discordant / unclassified_typeI / low best_lwr)
unclassified_typeI is a deliberate queryable outcome (84 reference tips + propagated queries)
placed-query labels depend on reference-tip labels at the placement edge; each carries best_lwr for downstream filtering

step9_function.description: Functional (ion-transport / sensory / channel / enzyme) and spectral-tuning annotation from helix-C active-site motif + phylogenetic subfamily, with strict measured/inferred/predicted separation.

active_site_columns.note: Raw-alignment column indices in qc_candidates_PF01036.sto anchored on P02945 full-length precursor numbering.

method.helixC_motif: 3-residue string at BR mature positions 85/89/96 read per sequence.

functional_rules.principle: Ion PUMPS defined by active-site chemistry (motif authoritative); CHANNELS/SENSORS/ENZYMES defined by architecture/phylogeny (Step-8 subfamily primary). Both signals always recorded.
functional_rules.variant_rules: D+[TS]+[DE]->H+ pump; N..Q (NDQ-family)->Na+ pump; N+[TS]+[NQ]->anion pump; D+[TS]+non-carboxylate->sensory-like (no proton donor).
functional_rules.discordance_flag: motif_agrees=False when motif chemistry and subfamily clade imply different classes; for pump clades motif chemistry takes precedence and discordance is surfaced.

spectral_rules.switch: proteorhodopsin position 105 L/Q: Leu->green (~525 nm), Gln->blue (~490 nm).
spectral_rules.restriction: Color prediction emitted ONLY for the proteorhodopsin subfamily (switch validated there); all other subfamilies record the residue but no color call.
spectral_rules.evidence_status: ALL lambda_max here are PREDICTED (tuning-residue proxy); lambda_max_measured_nm reserved, never imputed.

caveats: Functional class is INFERRED from active-site chemistry + phylogeny, NOT experimentally assayed (function_is_inferred=True).

Eukaryote-skewed 278-tip backbone (Step 7) causes some eukaryotic proton-pump (DTD/DTE) sequences to place near the halorhodopsin clade; classifier resolves these by motif chemistry and flags motif_agrees=False (859 discordances).
lambda_max values are proxy PREDICTIONS from a single tuning residue; real lambda_max depends on the full retinal pocket.
Spectral prediction restricted to proteorhodopsins; BR/xanthorhodopsin carry Leu at the aligned position but their lambda_max is not governed by this single switch, so no color is predicted for them.

step10_structure.description: Structural annotation: experimental PDB mapping (RCSB), representative-structure selection, domain/fusion architecture, and ESMFold prediction for clade reps lacking experimental structure.

method.pdb_source: UniProt PDB cross-references in candidates_L1; metadata via RCSB GraphQL data API.
method.representative_selection: Prefer retinal-bound (holo) structure, then X-ray over EM/NMR, then best resolution.
method.retinal_detection: nonpolymer ligand chem_comp id in {RET,RTL,RAL,6ZR,60R,ATR,BRT} (RET = all-trans retinal).
method.fusion_domains: Extra Pfam domains beyond PF01036/PF18761 mapped to functional roles (cyclase/HisKinase/etc).
method.esmfold: ESMCFold2 (full) on GPU for 1 rep of each subfamily with no experimental structure among backbone tips.

caveats: Experimental structures cover only 66 of 4886 sequences (well-studied model proteins); the vast majority have no 3D structure.
Some representative structures are apo (no retinal) when higher-resolution holo forms are unavailable; retinal presence recorded per-structure.
ESMFold predictions (2) are single-chain monomer models; mean pLDDT ~93 indicates high local confidence but oligomeric state and retinal pocket are not modeled with the cofactor.

step11_database.description: Normalized relational SQLite database (12 tables + denormalized v_master view), Python query API, example notebook, and machine-readable data dictionary.

method.schema: source_acc (UniProt accession) universal key; central protein table + 1:1 satellites (qc_feature, membership, redundancy, subfamily, function, structure, predicted_structure); protein_pdb many-to-many junction to pdb_structure entity; seed & citation reference tables.
method.integrity: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON with explicit FK constraints; verified PRAGMA foreign_key_check=0 violations, integrity_check=ok.
method.view: v_master LEFT JOINs all satellites onto protein for one-row-per-protein queries.
method.api: api/microrhododb_api.py (stdlib sqlite3 + pandas, read-only URI connection).

step12_release.description: Publication figures, methods/results report, and automated release validation gate.

figure2_phylogeny.encoding: tips coloured by subfamily via aligned right-margin marker column; 8 curated seeds as square markers; branch lengths in substitutions/site; presented unrooted
figure2_phylogeny.palette: maximally-separable 12-colour qualitative (channelrhodopsin=black, proteorhodopsin=forest green split to remove green-green collision)
figure2_phylogeny.media_check: PASS (direct visual confirmation; strip legible, seeds distinct, legend complete)

report.citations_verified: all inline [N] map to citation table ref_id (1,2,5,7,8,9,10,11,12,13)
